items.title: Mozambique: Economy minister calls for tourism reforms and stronger PPPs
items.summary: The Mozambican Minister of Economy, Basílio Muhate, has called for measures aimed at boosting reforms in the tourism sector by strengthening public-private partnerships (PPPs), as well as integrating micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) into the tourism value chain.
